title: AgentSkillsLock
description: Resolved lockfile generated by skpm. Pins exact skill versions, registry locations, artifact names, SHA256 checksums, and install paths. This file is generated and must not be edited manually. Commit it to your repository.

version.description: Lockfile format version. Must be 1 for this schema.

resolved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the lockfile was generated. Optional. Omitting it enables deterministic lockfile output across runs.

skills.description: Resolved skill entries. Each entry is a fully pinned skill with exact version, artifact, and checksum.

LockedSkill.title: LockedSkill
LockedSkill.description: A fully resolved and pinned skill entry in the lockfile.

namespace.description: Skill namespace. 'default' when the skill has no explicit namespace.

version.description: Resolved exact SemVer version. Must not be a range or 'latest'.

constraint.description: The original version constraint from agent-skills.yaml that was resolved to produce this entry. Retained for auditability.

source.description: Registry name from agent-skills.yaml that this skill was resolved from.

registry_type.description: Registry adapter type used to resolve and download this skill.

registry_url.description: Base URL of the registry that served this skill.

artifact.description: Filename of the resolved package artifact.

download_url.description: Full URL to download the artifact. Must be a valid URI if present.

sha256.description: SHA256 digest of the package artifact in lowercase hexadecimal. Verified by skpm on every install.

package_type.description: Archive format of the package artifact.

compatible_with.description: Agent platforms declared as compatible by this skill version.

installed_to.description: Filesystem paths where skpm installed this skill in the consuming project.

source_commit.description: Git commit SHA of the skill source at the resolved version, if available from the registry.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature over the artifact, if the registry provided one. Format is registry-defined.

provenance.description: SLSA provenance attestation or similar supply-chain metadata URI, if available.

metadata.description: Freeform extension metadata retained from the registry response or resolver. Must not contain secrets.
